## Fixed
- **Every Lonsdaleite recipe now works on Minecraft 1.21.1.** All 30 recipes were written in a newer format that 1.21.1 cannot read, so the game skipped them and nothing could be crafted — including Raw Lonsdaleite, which every other item depends on. This affected the 1.21.1 build only.

## Changed
- Internal packaging metadata (`pack.mcmeta`) now declares the correct resource and data pack formats for Minecraft 1.21.1.

## Notes
- No changes to recipes, materials, or item behaviour — the recipes are exactly as documented, they simply load now.
- Other Minecraft versions were unaffected and are unchanged.
